integrity: The primary source was inspected at the exact sharp-root theorem, its sharpness proof, numerical table, and the later theorem reusing the same radius. The new change of variables was algebraically reconstructed from the published root equation. Monotonicity, both profile limits, the simultaneous scaling law, and the balanced-ray closed form were proved analytically; numerical roots were used only as sanity checks.
scientific_limitations: The result analyzes only the sharp radius R_{1,k,m,p} from Theorem 3.1 for 0<p<=2. The Lambert-W formula is asymptotic as m/k tends to zero, not an exact closed form for general ratios. No uniform remainder is claimed across the two boundary regimes.
title: Exact logarithmic scaling profile for sharp Schwarz–Bohr radii
